title.zh: Sunder 1.2.0：公告刷新、诊断 CLI 与文档补齐
title.en: Sunder 1.2.0: refresh announcements, a doctor CLI and fuller docs

body.zh: sunder_notice 新增 action=refresh，立即重拉公告 feed 并回报 unread / source / feed_error；sunder_status 增加 announce_limit 行，feed_error 反映最近一次真实错误。浏览器横幅条数上限收到 3，与宿主 announceLimit 默认值一致。新增只读诊断 node scripts/doctor.mjs（10 项检查，退出码 0/1/2，--json 可机读，npm run doctor 同义），配套 test/doctor.mjs，CI 增加 doctor 测试并补上 tag 触发的发布工作流与 CodeQL 扫描。文档补 CONTRIBUTING.md、SECURITY.md、docs/PROMPTS.md 与英文 README。装完仍需重启 DSH。
body.en: sunder_notice gains action=refresh, which re-pulls the announcement feed on the spot and reports unread / source / feed_error; sunder_status now prints announce_limit, and its feed_error line shows the most recent real failure. The browser banner caps at 3 entries, matching the host's default announceLimit. New read-only diagnostics: node scripts/doctor.mjs (ten checks, exit 0/1/2, --json for machines, npm run doctor as an alias), with test/doctor.mjs, a doctor step in CI and tag-triggered release plus CodeQL workflows. Docs: CONTRIBUTING.md, SECURITY.md, docs/PROMPTS.md and an English README. Restart DSH after installing.

body.zh: 首个公开版本：启用后，部署 persona 会被 Sunder 提示词包替换，当前会话的下一轮请求立即生效。内置公告与更新检查，可在插件配置里关闭。
body.en: First public release. Once enabled, the deployment persona is replaced by the Sunder prompt pack and the very next request in any open conversation picks it up. Announcements and update checks are built in and can be turned off in the plugin config.

title.zh: Sunder 1.1.0：预设、状态卡片与一键安装
title.en: Sunder 1.1.0: presets, a status card and one-command install

body.zh: 三档提示词预设（full / concise / dev）、新工具 sunder_config 与 sunder_prompt；sunder_update 新增 action=apply，可在会话里直接装上最新 release（先快照到 $DSH_HOME/sunder/backups，校验包名后才写盘）。另附 scripts/install.mjs / uninstall.mjs 一键挂载 profile，以及随包浏览器端设置卡片与未读公告横幅。配置项新增 preset、feedUrl、feedMirrors、builtinMirrors、bundledAnnouncements、repo。装完仍需重启 DSH。
body.en: Three prompt presets (full / concise / dev), two new tools (sunder_config, sunder_prompt), and an action=apply mode for sunder_update that installs the latest release from inside a conversation: it snapshots the install under $DSH_HOME/sunder/backups first and only writes after the package name checks out. scripts/install.mjs and uninstall.mjs attach the bundle to a profile in one command, and a bundled browser card plus unread-announcement banner surface status in the DSH settings. New config keys: preset, feedUrl, feedMirrors, builtinMirrors, bundledAnnouncements, repo. Restart DSH after installing.
